“你跟厉雨是什么关系？”

“没有关系，一面之缘。”

审讯室里，林舒神情镇静。

----当然是装出来的！

这还是他第一次经历这种场面。

冰冷的审讯椅、对面坐着的神情严肃、脸上一条刀疤贯穿、看上去凶神恶煞的警察、还有头顶惨白又刺眼的吊灯。

虽然没给自己上铐子，审讯椅也没上锁，但这氛围属实是压抑到了极点。

他心里其实很紧张，但不知道为什么，他确实不怎么害怕。

大概是在见识到“仪轨”的力量之后，自己看待这个世界的视角，已经发生了本质性的变化。

寻常的事情变得不寻常，而类似于“讯问”这种不寻常的事情，却又有些不值一提了。

能怎么的？

现在还只是询问，不是“审讯”嘛。

他们拿自己没办法的！

林舒稍稍定了定神，没等对面的男人继续发问，便抢先开口回答道：

“我是在步行街喝咖啡的时候遇到他的，当时他突然晕倒了，我打算把他送到医院去，但是他半路醒了，坚持不去医院，我就把他带到我家休息了。”

“他睡了差不多大半天，起来以后自己离开了，我们之后互相留了联系方式，但只是简单打了个电话......”

“等等！”

对面的刀疤男----也就是贺成----抬手打断了林舒。

他直视着林舒的眼睛，语气中带着不容置疑的威严，开口说道：

“林舒，我可以跟你明说，现在我们没有把你列为嫌疑人，只是把你作为关键证人对待！”

“如果你再这么跟我们对抗，那后面的事情我就没办法跟你保证了。”

“我可以坦白地跟你说，我们需要你的帮助。”

“你可以选择不帮我们，但这件事情非常严重，案情非常重大，甚至可能在后续对你也造成重大影响！”

“你不要把自己置于危险中，明白吗！？”

话音落下，林舒的心里咯噔一下。

把自己置于危险中？

对自己的处境，对方似乎是清楚的。

----或者，就算对方不清楚，似乎也已经有了一些初步的推论。

如果要寻求庇护，这时或许确实是不错的时机。

但.....仪轨。

这个秘密实在是太大了，自己根本就还没有想好，要不要向“官方”这个更大的势力坦白。

林舒心里有了决定。

他们还没有发现徐长顺的电脑、也还没有确认那些事情的真实性。

"What is your relationship with Li Yu?"

"It doesn't matter, it's just a one-sided relationship."

In the interrogation room, Lin Shu looked calm.

----Of course I'm pretending!

This is the first time he has experienced such a scene.

There was a cold interrogation chair, a serious looking policeman with a scar running through his face, and a dazzling white chandelier above his head.

Although he was not cuffed and the interrogation chair was not locked, the atmosphere was extremely depressing.

He was actually very nervous, but he didn't know why, but he wasn't really afraid.

Probably after seeing the power of "rituals", my perspective on the world has fundamentally changed.

Ordinary things become unusual, and unusual things like "interrogation" are not worth mentioning.

What can be done?

Now it's just an inquiry, not an "interrogation".

They can't do anything about it!

Lin Shu calmed down for a moment, and before the man across from him could continue to ask questions, he answered first:

"I met him while drinking coffee on the pedestrian street. He suddenly fainted. I planned to take him to the hospital, but he woke up halfway and insisted not to go to the hospital, so I took him to my house to rest."

"He slept for most of the day and left on his own after getting up. We later left each other's contact information, but we just made a simple phone call..."

"Wait!"

The scarred man opposite, He Cheng, raised his hand to interrupt Lin Shu.

He looked directly into Lin Shu's eyes, with unquestionable majesty in his tone, and said:

"Lin Shu, I can tell you clearly that now we do not list you as a suspect, we only treat you as a key witness!"

"If you continue to confront us like this, I won't be able to guarantee you what will happen next."

"I can tell you frankly, we need your help."

"You can choose not to help us, but this matter is very serious and the case is very important. It may even have a major impact on you in the future!"

"Don't put yourself in danger, understand!?"

After the words fell, Lin Shu's heart skipped a beat.

Putting yourself in danger?

The other party seems to be aware of his situation.

----Or, even if the other party doesn't know clearly, he seems to have some preliminary inferences.

If you want to seek asylum, this may indeed be a good time.

But... rituals.

This secret is really too big, and I haven't even thought about whether to confess it to the larger force called "officials".

Lin Shu made a decision in his mind.

They have not yet discovered Xu Changshun's computer, nor have they confirmed the authenticity of those things.
